sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; no provider credits required
sources.purpose: Bound Playwright API calls and use narrowly scoped transport retry for ECONNRESET instead of blind HTTP-status retries in CORE-05 browser/API workers
sources.reliability_limits: Playwright Python APIRequestContext defaults to a 30-second request timeout and zero retries. max_retries currently retries only ECONNRESET and does not retry HTTP status codes; provider-specific 429/403/402 handling and idempotency rules remain separate concerns.
sources.source_name: Playwright Python APIRequestContext timeout and max_retries

sources.reliability_limits: Explains account review and revocation; does not reveal which apps are currently authorized, and account settings require login

sources.cost_quota: free
sources.purpose: Serialize repository-writing workflows without dropping pending runs
sources.reliability_limits: Concurrency groups serialize only workflows using the same group; queue max holds at most 100 pending runs and execution ordering depends on queue start time

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; no API credit used
sources.purpose: Ground Shorts editing primitives in YouTube's current editor capabilities: clip trim/reorder, timeline precision, timed text, voiceover, audio-level control and beat synchronization
sources.reliability_limits: Documents available creation/editing features, not causal retention gains from any editing technique. Feature availability can vary by device/app version/region; technique performance must be tested against owned analytics.
sources.source_name: YouTube Enhance your Shorts editing tools

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; cache storage above the included threshold can incur charges
sources.purpose: Reduce repeated dependency downloads and CI runtime/cost while preserving cache-miss fallback and safe cache boundaries
sources.reliability_limits: Caches are optimization only and jobs must remain able to regenerate dependencies. Restored cache content should be treated as untrusted; low-trust triggers have restricted write behavior, and excessive cache storage can cause eviction or billing.

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation
sources.purpose: Handle GitHub REST primary and secondary rate limits with header-aware bounded backoff instead of blind retries
sources.reliability_limits: Applies to GitHub REST API rate limiting. Secondary limits can change without notice, and this does not describe quotas imposed by third-party connectors or model providers. Response headers remain authoritative for the current request.

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; no API credit used
sources.purpose: Validate the technical upload encoding of the daily Shorts MP4 before publishing
sources.reliability_limits: Specifies container, codecs, channel layout, sample rate and bitrate. It does not prove that narration exists, is intelligible, matches the script, or is loud enough; those require separate content-level QC.

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation
sources.purpose: Review and revoke GitHub App authorizations for the Knowledge Library and system integrations
sources.reliability_limits: Explains account review and revocation; does not reveal current app installations or permissions, and account settings require login

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; trace artifacts consume CI artifact storage only when retained/uploaded
sources.purpose: Capture Playwright trace diagnostics on the first retry of flaky browser/CI failures so CORE-05 can distinguish selector/timing/navigation failures without always recording expensive traces
sources.reliability_limits: Playwright recommends trace on first retry for CI tests. Trace data improves diagnosis but does not fix flaky behavior, and traces can contain page snapshots/screenshots or sensitive page state, so retention/upload must follow secret/privacy rules.
sources.source_name: Playwright Trace Viewer and CI tracing

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation
sources.purpose: Verify payment gateway availability by store country before changing a live Shopify payment configuration
sources.reliability_limits: Regional listing can differ from the store admin because of current payment configuration; it does not prove provider approval or activation for this store

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; shorter retention can reduce stored CI diagnostic data
sources.purpose: Set deliberate retention for CORE-05 workflow logs, checks and diagnostic artifacts so CI evidence remains long enough for debugging without retaining low-value data indefinitely
sources.reliability_limits: GitHub documents 90-day default retention and repository-specific ranges; starting October 1, 2026 retention settings also apply to checks, workflow runs and commit statuses. Shortening retention can remove evidence needed for later diagnosis, applies only to new objects, and should be chosen by evidence value rather than blindly minimized.

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation
sources.purpose: Choose least-privilege GitHub App permissions for repository automation and connected tools
sources.reliability_limits: Defines permission classes and required capabilities but does not reveal the permissions granted to this account's installed apps
sources.source_name: Choosing permissions for a GitHub App

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; no API credit used
sources.purpose: Classify current 1-3 minute square/vertical uploads as Shorts and keep copyright-claim handling current
sources.reliability_limits: Classification and claim behavior do not guarantee recommendation, monetization or engagement. YouTube states that from 24 September 2026 new Shorts longer than one minute but under three minutes with an active Content ID claim are no longer automatically blocked and may remain playable; individual claims can still block content and must be resolved.

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation
sources.purpose: Bound CORE-05 worker/CI jobs with explicit job or step timeout-minutes so hung external/API/browser operations fail closed instead of consuming the default six-hour job window
sources.reliability_limits: GitHub documents a 360-minute default job timeout; the correct shorter timeout is workload-specific. A timeout limits hangs/cost but does not replace application-level request timeouts, bounded retries, cleanup, or artifact/QC verification.

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; no API credit used
sources.purpose: Gate the daily Short against YouTube originality, reused-content and mass-produced/inauthentic-content monetization rules before production or publishing
sources.reliability_limits: Policy eligibility is assessed at channel level and does not guarantee monetization, copyright clearance, fair use, distribution or engagement. A transformed clip may still be subject to copyright and other policies.

sources.cost_quota: free
sources.purpose: POSIX flock semantics for concurrent local catalog writes
sources.reliability_limits: Unix-only; does not coordinate independent GitHub runners or replace branch conflict checks

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; no API credit used
sources.purpose: Use automatic-caption generation and manual review as an additional intelligibility check for the daily Shorts narration before publishing
sources.reliability_limits: Automatic captions can misrepresent speech and may be unavailable for reasons including poor sound, long silence, overlapping speakers or unsupported language. Caption presence alone does not prove narration loudness, sync, completeness or engagement.

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; artifact attestations are available for public repositories on current GitHub plans
sources.purpose: Add verifiable build provenance to release artifacts and support CORE-05 artifact verification without treating provenance as a substitute for smoke/QC tests
sources.reliability_limits: Attestations establish provenance and integrity claims, not that an artifact is safe or functionally correct. GitHub recommends them for consumable/release artifacts rather than frequent test-only builds; verification is required to realize the security benefit.
sources.source_name: GitHub Actions artifact attestations for build provenance

sources.cost_quota: free
sources.purpose: Serialize repository content writes and require current blob SHA for updates
sources.reliability_limits: Contents API writes can conflict; independent writers must re-read current SHA and serialize updates

sources.cost_quota: free public documentation
sources.purpose: Interpret OAuth scopes and assess least-privilege requirements for connected tools
sources.reliability_limits: Defines scope capabilities but does not expose the scopes granted to any current installation; account or API inspection is still required
